name: Large inflows from state-owned entities or ministries to private accounts
description: Funds from government bodies or state enterprises arrive at private or personal accounts with no apparent contractual basis.
fp: State suppliers and contractors receive government funds legitimately.

sources.text: FATF, Laundering the Proceeds of Corruption (2011)
FATF, Guidance on Politically Exposed Persons (Recommendations 12 and 22) (2013)
World Bank StAR and UNODC, Politically Exposed Persons: Preventive Measures for the Banking Sector (2010)
World Bank StAR, The Puppet Masters (2011)
